summary: ECARX filed a Form 6-K announcing an amendment to its 2025 Convertible Notes, upsizing the total capacity from $100M to $130M. An existing investor subscribed for an additional $15M note, and a prior $15M note was transferred to a new investor. The conversion price is $2.62 with a 2028 maturity. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. The filing contains no M&A, activist, restructuring, or similar event.
